==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Farosh}}
Farosh is one of three roaming [[Dragon]]s in [[Hyrule]], the others being [[Naydra]] and [[Dinraal]]. It is the servant of the [[Spring of Courage]], and it has been described as a [[Spirit]] of [[Lightning]] that takes the form of a Dragon. According to old legends, Farosh flies into the sky when the sun begins to set, but no modern accounts of such an occurrence exist.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/>

While it cannot be defeated, Farosh does not actively try to harm [[Link]]. However, if Link gets too close, he will be damaged by the [[Electricity]] surrounding its body.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium"/> This can be avoided by wearing the [[Thunder Helm]] or the full [[Rubber Armor (Set)|Rubber Armor]] [[Armor Set|Set]] that has been enhanced twice by a [[Great Fairy]], both of which grant Link the [[Unshockable|Lightning Proof]] [[Set Bonus]]. Farosh will drop different [[Material]]s if Link shoots it with a [[Bow]]. Depending on where Farosh is shot, it will drop a [[Shard of Farosh's Horn]], [[Shard of Farosh's Fang]], [[Farosh's Claw]] or [[Farosh's Scale]]. After being shot, the Dragon will disappear until the next in-game day.

Farosh's Scale can be dropped into the Spring of Courage to reveal a hidden [[Ancient Shrine]].

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
As part of the "[[Floria Bridge Protection]]" [[Quest]], [[Merchant]]s have become fearful of crossing [[Floria Bridge]], since they could be shocked by Farosh's [[Electricity]] as she passes by.<ref name="AoC Gallery"/> After the [[Warrior]]s provide Electricity-resistant [[Material]]s to the Merchants, they begin to travel over Floria Bridge again without having to worry about Farosh.<ref name="AoC Gallery 2"/>
{{Noncanon|End}}

* When Farosh passes under the [[Floria Bridge]] in {{BotW|-}}, parts of its body partially phase through the bridge. In the event that an NPC is crossing the bridge at the same time, their shield can be hit by the dragon. The NPC does not react to this.

==Nomenclature==
Farosh's name is derived from [[Farore]], the Goddess of Courage.
